About

I'm a Data & AI Engineer from Türkiye.

My work has mostly revolved around one broad question: how do we turn messy information and complicated processes into systems that are actually useful?

That has taken me through data engineering, machine learning, operations research, knowledge graphs, backend development and, more recently, LLM and agentic AI systems.

I've worked on projects across pharma, retail, finance, venture capital and optimization-heavy environments. Depending on the problem, my work has ranged from building ETL pipelines and data models to designing RAG systems, optimizing distributed processing and building backend services.

Teaching has become an important part of my professional life. I've conducted hundreds of technical interviews, mentored engineers, organized workshops and given talks on topics ranging from Python and databases to GraphRAG, AI systems and software engineering.

I enjoy situations where technology meets something less technical: how people make decisions, how teams work, how we learn, and how tools change our way of thinking.

This website is where I collect things I've built, ideas I'm exploring, articles, and whatever else I find worth remembering or sharing.
